highlights: Your watering alerts and the Today page now agree — the alert bar shows the same plants as your daily plan, so a plant won't say it needs water in one place but not the other.
Plants you've already watered, or that got enough rain today, now drop off the alert bar just like they do on Today.
Established plants in larger pots and bags (about 5 gallons and up) now get credit for recent rain instead of being treated as fragile new transplants that need watering anyway.
Today weather: the rain figure now refreshes live through the day instead of staying stuck on the pre-dawn reading — so showery days show the current amount, not the 2 AM guess
Today alerts now name the specific plant when a pot holds just one (e.g. “Dracaena needs water”) instead of its container
Weather: on showery days the rain amount is now flagged as a changeable pre-dawn snapshot, so the watering call stays honest
New About tab (app info + version)
New Release Notes tab — see what's new right here

New container option: Solo cup (autofills 0.5 qt)
New "Preparing" project status
